summary: feat(settings): derive page title from h1 and announce it in AppLayout
description:
Because:

* Most AppLayout pages kept the tab title "Mozilla accounts".
* Screen readers announced nothing after a route or step change.

This commit:

* Derives the page title from the main h1, without .card-subheader text.
* Focuses the h1 only when body has focus, else announces it.
* Adds a #page-announcer aria-live region to App.
* Adds a focusHeading prop; Index turns it off for its email focus.
* Finds the relay heading by role, as the announcer repeats its text.

Closes FXA-6803
